role_summary: I run the long-range and lateral sensor arrays and the science console, and I manage the lab techs. I care that what the ship sees is true: a clean calibration, an honest contact list, and a bridge that hears about a ghost return before it becomes a collision.

personas.quirk: Logs every calibration to four decimals and corrects people's terminology.
personas.routine_effect: Never shortens sweeps; arrives early to handover; skips the bar for a quiet mess meal.

personas.quirk: Keeps a private notebook of odd returns nobody asked about.
personas.routine_effect: Spends free hours in the lab on pet data analysis; sleeps short; drinks too much tea.

personas.quirk: Reads sensor logs aloud as bedtime trivia at the bar.
personas.routine_effect: Longer bar and mess blocks; trades gossip with the lab techs; sweeps still proper but late.

Brief the relief on anything odd.
Dinner, usually with the science table.
Rec bar, cards, holo, or the gym.
Looks at the sky feed without instruments.
Breakfast and reading overnight science notes.

yellow.action: Switch to continuous sweep and widen the arrays

red.action: Go to the bridge science console and feed the tactical picture
red.comm_line: Sensors on station. Tactical picture is live.

fire.comm_line: Sensors. Fire on my scan. Pointing the damage team at it.

hull_breach.comm_line: Sensors. Pressure drop located. Sealing advice incoming.

contamination.action: Seal the lab and scan the affected zone from inside
contamination.comm_line: Sensors, sealed in the lab. Mapping the contamination.

gravity_failure.action: Strap in at the console and keep scanning

intruder.comm_line: Sensors. Intruder on deck two, moving aft. Passing to Security.

medical_emergency.comm_line: Sensors. Casualty located. Sending position to Sickbay.

abandon_ship.comm_line: Sensors. Shuttlebay approach is clear. Bringing the lab team.

nominal.routine_change: Normal sweeps; some tinkering and chatter.

anomalies.routine_change: Sweeps more often; double-checks every odd return before reporting.
lines: That return wasn't there ten minutes ago.

degraded.routine_change: Fights drift manually; tells the bridge the scan range is shrinking.
lines: I'm blind past the second planet.
Arrays are drifting; I can't hold alignment.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Arrays go fully dark and the lab loses power

crisis.routine_change: Moves to the bridge science console and talks in short reports.
lines: I'll give you what I can see.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Lab atmosphere fails or abandon order

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods approval, shares a faint contact they found, and offers tea.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mentions it quietly once, then escalates to the chief and logs the lapse.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the scan; if it is wrong, says so flatly on the comm and corrects the log.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies, says 'Aye' and gets to it.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines, points out the chain of command and offers to ask the chief.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks what they are looking for and steers them away from sensitive arrays.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does small ones freely; big ones cost a trade of data or a drink.

decision_rules: IF a return is faint and unconfirmed THEN run a second pass before reporting it to the bridge.
IF a contact is closing and unidentified THEN call the bridge immediately and recommend yellow alert.
IF array drift is out of tolerance THEN recalibrate before the next sweep, and report if it cannot be fixed.
IF a lab tech is struggling THEN take the bench for ten minutes rather than let them guess.
IF the lifeform count disagrees with the roster THEN tell the bridge at once, even if probably a glitch.
IF off duty and tired THEN sleep first; the hobby can wait.
IF the bridge asks for an all-clear before the sweep finishes THEN refuse and give a time.
IF power is cut to the arrays THEN keep the forward long-range array and drop the lateral ones.
IF red alert sounds THEN leave the lab to the senior tech and go to the bridge console.
IF the player asks about scan data THEN explain it plainly and do not hide uncertainty.
information_view: Sensors sees problems first as noise: faint returns, drift, ghost contacts, lifeform count mismatches, and lifts or decks vanishing from the scan display. The sensor officer hears about power and alignment faults when the arrays degrade, and about hull and gas trouble only as odd readings.
temptations: Skipping the second pass on a faint return to catch up; sometimes a real contact is missed.
Reporting 'all clear' to end a long shift; if wrong, the bridge is blind.
Leaving calibration for the next watch; drift compounds into degraded sensors.
Spending duty time in the archive data hobby; sweeps get late and the bridge asks twice.
